verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.cubic.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a cubic documentation index. Docs pages are served as raw .md files that point agents back to that index. cubic also publishes agent skills that give coding agents instructions for using its codebase context. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content dump, and no independent confirmation of how complete or useful the llms.txt index is in practice.
